name: @oat/mocks
description: Local stand-ins for third-party APIs (LLM, STT, Notion, Google Calendar). Runs in the compose stack on :14010.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/main.js --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
